sub_problems.fills: The plan migration selects only tickets still in flight: a ticket whose cursor stands at a terminal is never opened for write. The terminal set is the class definition's (path ends plus dispositions)
sub_problems.what: D1: migrate's selector reads each class's terminal set (path ends plus dispositions) from <root>/node_classes, united with workflow_grammar.TERMINAL_STATES.
sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-16: plan_migration._proved called a ticket open whenever its workflow lacked '[PROVED]'. On the house commons that selected 264 tickets, 52 of them at a terminal cursor (38 SUPERSEDED, 11 RETIRED, 3 DROPPED). akienasus's dry run over its commons would have rewritten 26 terminal tick
